method: Independently read every16actual source/target entry and representative callsites before separate meaning/editor findings. Verified source file hashes, generation-disabled vs active-request conditions, numeric credit cap validation, comparison heading suffix, and existing shipped Thai Project/Building-credit pricing copy. Agent-reviewed, not native-human-certified.

rationales.eligibility_and_charge: Discussion requires an available credit without spending it; creation charge explicitly occurs on delivery. All four product variants preserve this distinction.
rationales.generation: Generation translated as creating works/maps/music, avoiding provider draft implication of physical construction.
rationales.request_cap: Actual code validates an integer credit budget1..maxRequestCredits, so เพดานเครดิตต่อคำขอ is precise.
rationales.music_comparison: Leading separator and กำลังเปรียบเทียบ are suitable appended version heading; allthree moods retained.
rationales.building_credit: เครดิตอาคาร exactly matches existing shipped pricing sentence, while เครดิตสร้างอาคาร is a concise label variant of same product.
